stories.title: Mumbai: Scooty rider killed after falling under BEST bus in Kurla
stories.summary: A 25-year-old scooty rider was killed after falling underneath a Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) bus following a collision with a tempo while attempting to overtake the bus in Kurla West on Tuesday morning, November 24. The deceased, identified as Ajay Gunavant Patil, was declared brought dead at Rajawadi Hospital, where he was taken following the accident.

stories.title: 2 Killed, 17 Injured As Private Bus Overturns On Samruddhi Expressway
stories.summary: Sourced Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: Two passengers died and 17 others sustained injuries after a private passenger bus travelling from Nagpur to Mumbai overturned on the Samruddhi Expressway in the early hours of Monday. 10 am on Nov 23, 2026, near Naigaon Shivar in Phulambri taluka of Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar district, at chainage number 426 on the Nagpur-Mumbai stretch of the expressway.

stories.title: FDA fines Mumbai University canteen Rs 1 lakh for operating without food licence
stories.summary: The canteen operating at Mumbai University’s Fort campus has been fined R1 lakh after it was found to be operating without a valid food licence and multiple food safety and hygiene violations following an inspection by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on November 22-23. Officials found several lapses, including food handlers working without prescribed uniforms and protective clothing.

stories.title: Sonu Nigam adds fourth Mumbai commercial property worth Rs 31.47 crore; three Andheri units already earn
stories.summary: Sonu Nigam has made another significant investment in Mumbai's commercial real estate market. 47 crore, adding a fourth unit to his portfolio in the city. The acquisition comes after the singer purchased three commercial units in Andheri West earlier this year. Those properties reportedly bring him a combined monthly rental income of Rs 12 lakh.

stories.summary: Mumbai Police on Monday detained two more minor boys in connection with the assault on a young man and his female friend at a public garden in Kurla West , taking the total number of apprehensions in the case to eight.

stories.title: Elphinstone Road double decker ROB reaches 63 per cent completion
stories.summary: A new double-decker bridge is set to take shape at Elphinstone Road in Mumbai as part of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority’s ( MMRDA ) Sewri-Worli Connector project, with construction of the main railway overbridge (ROB) reaching 63 per cent completion. Issuing an official statement, MMRDA said that work is also progressing steadily on the approach roads at both the Sewri and Worli ends of the bridge.

stories.title: Mumbai water cut: BMC announces 24-hour supply disruption on November 26-27
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has announced a 24-hour water supply disruption in several parts of Mumbai on November 26 and 27 due to scheduled repairs to major water pipelines between Powai High-Level Reservoir No. 1 (PHLR-1) and Sahar Village. According to the civic body, repair work will begin at 9 am on Thursday, November 26, and continue until 9 am on Friday, November 27, 2026.

stories.title: Maharashtra: Duronto Express window damaged in stone-pelting near Nagpur
stories.summary: The outer glass pane of a window in the Nagpur-Mumbai Duronto Express was damaged after an unidentified person allegedly pelted stones at the train near Manish Nagar, shortly after it passed Ajni Railway Station in Maharashtra's Nagpur district, railway authorities said. The incident took place on November 23 when the Mumbai-bound train was passing through the area.

stories.title: Mumbai Police’s new drug-testing van catches 12 concertgoers 2 days after launch
stories.summary: As thousands of music lovers made their way out of Mahalaxmi Racecourse for Anyma’s Aeden World Tour on Sunday, some concertgoers found themselves being stopped by Mumbai Police and asked to undergo an unusual check – an oral swab test to detect drug consumption.

stories.title: Mumbai Emerges As Asia-Pacific’s Real Estate Hotspot, Secures Spot Among Top 10 Investment Destinations
stories.summary: Strong commercial demand, infrastructure development and the availability of investment-grade properties are strengthening Mumbai's position as a global real estate investment hub. Mumbai's status as India's financial and commercial capital continues to attract multinational companies and institutional investors. Infrastructure projects such as the Mumbai Trans Harbour Link and Navi Mumbai International Airport are improving regional connectivity and unlocking new real estate development opportunities across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR).

stories.title: Man jumps to death from Belapur court’s 5th floor minutes after receiving life sentence for sister’s murder
stories.summary: The deceased, Nagesh Lad, an autorickshaw driver from Nerul, had been lodged in the Taloja jail for the past seven years. Police commissioner Milind Bharambe said, “Technically, it’s a custodial death of the undertrial as he was in custody of police while being escorted to Taloja jail. ”On July 17, 2019, Lad stabbed to death his sister Sunita Singh (29) and injured his wife Jyotsna (23).

stories.summary: MMRC’s Rehabilitation and Resettlement Department issued a public notice on Monday, asking property owners and occupants of potentially affected structures to cooperate with the survey team and provide the required documents. stories.title: BMC fines park contractor ₹1 lakh after couple assaulted in Mumbai’s Kurla
stories.summary: Two days after a young couple from Navi Mumbai was assaulted by a group of minors at Pramod Mahajan Park in Kurla West, the BMC has issued a show-cause notice to the contractor responsible for the park’s maintenance and security and imposed a fine of ₹ 1 lakh for alleged negligence.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC demolishes 10 structures for Mahim Causeway bridge project
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has demolished 10 project-affected structures to clear a major hurdle in the reconstruction and widening of the Mahim Causeway bridge. The demolition drive, carried out on Monday, November 23, marks a significant step towards reviving the infrastructure project, which had been delayed for the past six to seven years.

stories.title: Horror unfolds at Navi Mumbai court, life convict jumps to death moments after sentencing
stories.summary: In a shocking turn of events at a court in Thane district on Monday, a 28-year-old convict jumped to his death from the building’s fifth floor, minutes after being sentenced to life imprisonment for murdering his sister in 2019 and 10 years of rigorous imprisonment for attempting to murder his wife.

stories.title: Mumbai weather: City to see clear skies as temperatures hover around 34 deg C

stories.summary: The V Radha committee, appointed by the Maharashtra government to reform the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) , recruitment examination system, and curb paper leaks, submitted its second report on Monday recommending seven to 10 years’ imprisonment and a minimum fine of ₹ 10 crore for those involved in paper leaks.

stories.summary: Britain’s Prince William and Princess Catherine (Kate) has arrived in Mumbai for a three-day visit to India as part of the sixth edition of The Earthshot Prize.
